problem: A valid but older V3 receipt could be selected before a newer V2 receipt, or the first V3 item was selected regardless of timestamp.
root_cause: Client receipt selection prioritized storage generation and array order instead of the most recent valid proof.
prevention: Compare all timestamped valid receipts from every supported storage generation before choosing.
Preserve same-tenant authorization and explicit customer click through the existing /api/portal-scans handler.
Do not treat a locally saved receipt as real-tenant claim/readback evidence.
